name: FSS
shortDescription: 9-item clinical scale assessing how fatigue impacts physical functioning, motivation, and daily life.
timeframe: During the past week, indicate how much you agree with each statement (1 = Strongly disagree, 7 = Strongly agree):
citation: Krupp LB, LaRocca NG, Muir-Nash J, Steinberg AD. Arch Neurol. 1989;46(10):1121-1123.

questions.text: My motivation is lower when I am fatigued.
Fatigue interferes with my physical functioning.
Fatigue causes frequent problems for me.
My fatigue prevents sustained physical functioning.
Fatigue interferes with carrying out certain duties and responsibilities.
Fatigue is among my three most disabling symptoms.
Fatigue interferes with my work, family, or social life.

scoring.formulaDescription: Mean of all 9 items rated 1–7 (range 1.0–7.0; equivalent to total sum 9–63 divided by 9). A mean score of 4.0 or higher (sum ≥36) is the standard clinical cutoff indicating significant fatigue; scores ≥5.0 reflect high/severe fatigue.
